user.title: Qingdao Taneng Gas
user.description:
Enter the SESSION cookie captured from the WeChat official account. Leave user No. and meter No. empty to auto-detect.
Note: the API only allows residential broadband access; cloud servers, corporate networks and proxies are blocked.

reauth_confirm.title: Update credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The SESSION has expired. Please capture a new one and enter it below.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the server. Make sure Home Assistant runs on a residential broadband connection.
error.invalid_auth: SESSION is invalid or expired. Please capture a new one.
error.meter_not_found: No meter found for the given user No./meter No. Leave them empty to auto-detect.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

init.title: Taneng Gas options
init.description:
Update the SESSION here when it expires — no need to delete and re-add the integration. Leave SESSION empty to keep the current one.
If the cumulative reading differs from the official app by exactly one day's usage, toggle the calibration switch below.

data.include_base_day: Official reading already includes that day's usage
